ADDING FUNDS
Use cash, credit or debit card to add funds to your Tapp Pay smartphone or smartcard account.
Option 1: Payment Kiosks Payment kiosks are located at every RTA transit center. All RTA payment kiosks accept debit or credit cards. At the
Wright Stop Plaza Transit Center, the payment kiosks also accept cash.
Option 2: Online with the Tapp Pay Hub If you are using a smartcard, we encourage you to create a personalized account. All you need is a
valid email address and create a password.
Option 3: Retail Outlets RTA has partnered with Vanilla Direct to provide retail outlets where you can conveniently add funds to your account
via cash. Over 100 locations are located within close proximity to bus routes. Find retail outlets here www.iriderta.org/pay/where-add-funds.
